entries.en: to ride (a horse); to straddle
to ride on horseback

entries.zh: 纵；放开手脚、不拘束地走
entries.en: to go freely, unrestrained; to let go, move at liberty

entries.zh: 纵横；纵意恣行（伦理义：放纵不检）
entries.en: lengthwise and crosswise, to move freely; (morally) to indulge, be unrestrained
entries.notes: 词头含拉丁文 vt an grejo et in moralibus（疑脱讹），道德义须推断。

entries.zh: 〔原件残缺，释义存疑〕围拢；环绕而行
entries.en: to surround, encircle; to go around
entries.notes: [残]：闽音栏污损，官话对音 tuan 对应『团/围』字义；词头 ferrador 展开存疑。

entries.en: to go round in a circle; (of family) to reunite, be together in a ring
to go straight along the road, take the direct path
to walk sideways, crabwise
to hurry on one's way, hasten along the road
to drive (a carriage, oxen); to harness and guide

entries.zh: 齿露；龇牙咧嘴，牙齿外露
entries.en: to show one's teeth, bare the teeth
to walk with tiny steps, mince along
entries.notes: 官话对音 siào hiā 与汉字『小跌』对位略异，释义依词头 menudito 推断。

entries.zh: 轻行；脚步轻快细碎地快走
entries.en: to walk briskly with quick light steps
to walk with light little steps, tiptoe softly

entries.zh: 〔释义存疑〕头摇摇晃晃（头晕目眩状）
entries.en: for the head to sway or reel, to be dizzy
entries.notes: 汉字『佰眩』有疑（佰/两），词头 almodada 讹形难解，仅据对音 lia hiên（疑『累眩/离眩』）推为眩晕义。

entries.en: to crawl on all fours, go on hands and knees

entries.zh: 游方；云游四方，走遍天下
entries.en: to wander about the world, travel everywhere (as itinerant monk)
to tread over all the world, travel throughout the land

entries.zh: 独步行；独行（间隔大步、独自走路）
entries.en: to walk alone, pacing by oneself
entries.notes: 词头 espaçios 或为 espaceado（步阔）讹形，释义兼取『独』与『阔步』。

entries.zh: 大地步；迈开大步走（缓急皆可）
entries.en: to take long strides, whether slowly or quickly
the wheels of a cart, for the wheels to turn
entries.notes: 汉字『轮』有疑（轮/轆），词头 cache（carroça 车辆讹形）依语境推断。

entries.zh: 打跤；摔跤跌倒（打斗翻滚）
entries.en: to wrestle, tumble and fall; to scuffle
entries.notes: 汉字『跤』有疑（跤/破），词头 contrabajo 疑为 contravuelco/cayendo 讹形，据对音 tà pōa（打跤）定。
